top_sql.sql_sample: with selected_tasks as (               select CASE_PICK_TASK_ID,PICK_WAVE_ID from (                 select t.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID,t.PICK_WAVE_ID                   from RRL_CASE_PICK_TASK t                   join RRL_PICK_WAVE w on w.PICK_WAVE_ID=t.PICK_WAVE_ID                   join RRL_CUSTOMER_ORDER co on co.CUSTOMER_ORDER_ID=t.CUSTOMER_ORDER_ID                  where 1 = 1 and RRL_ACCESS_API.allowed(:view_actor,'case_pick_view','WAREHOUSE',to_char(t.WARE_ID),t.ASSIGNED_TO)=1 and t.STATUS not in ('READY_TO_SHIP', 'CANCELLED')                  order by t.STATUS,t.CREATED_AT,t.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID

select count(*) from RUSERS u where u.ID=:actor and nvl(u.DELETED,0)=0         and exists(select 1 from RRL_WARES w where (:ware is null or w.ID=:ware)         and RRL_ACCESS_API.allowed(:actor,'case_pick_view','WAREHOUSE',to_char(w.ID),:actor)=1)

select count(*) from RUSERS u where u.ID=:actor and nvl(u.DELETED,0)=0         and exists(select 1 from RRL_WARES w where (:ware is null or w.ID=:ware)         and RRL_ACCESS_API.allowed(:actor,'case_pick_view','WAREHOUSE',to_char(w.ID),:actor)=1)
select count(*) from RRL_CASE_PICK_TASK t where t.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID=:task and RRL_ACCESS_API.allowed(:view_actor,'case_pick_view','WAREHOUSE',to_char(t.WARE_ID),t.ASSIGNED_TO)=1
select count(*) from RRL_CASE_PICK_TASK t where t.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID=:task and RRL_ACCESS_API.allowed(:view_actor,'case_pick_view','WAREHOUSE',to_char(t.WARE_ID),t.ASSIGNED_TO)=1

SELECT COUNT(*)FROM RRL_TT_HU_LOAD_FACT LF JOIN RUSERS U ON U.ID=:B1 WHERE LF.LOAD_OPERATION_ID=:B2 AND LF.WARE_ID>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM RRL_WARES W WHERE W.ID=LF.WARE_ID)AND NVL(U.DELETED,0)=0 AND( (RRL_HAS_WRIGHT(U.ID,'stock_posting_shipping')=1 AND(UPPER(TRIM(U.USER_GROUP))='GLOBAL_ADMIN'OR U.WARE_ID=LF.WARE_ID)) OR RRL_ACCESS_API.ALLOWED(U.ID,'stock_posting_shipping','WAREHOUSE',RRL_STOCK_PLAN_HELPER.DECIMAL_TEXT(LF.WARE_ID))=1)

SELECT COUNT(*)FROM RRL_SBORKA_PALLETS S JOIN RUSERS U ON U.ID=:B1 WHERE S.PALLET_UID=:B2 AND NVL(U.DELETED,0)=0 AND( (RRL_HAS_WRIGHT(U.ID,'stock_posting_shipping')=1 AND(UPPER(TRIM(U.USER_GROUP))='GLOBAL_ADMIN'OR U.WARE_ID=S.WARE_ID)) OR RRL_ACCESS_API.ALLOWED(U.ID,'stock_posting_shipping','WAREHOUSE',RRL_STOCK_PLAN_HELPER.DECIMAL_TEXT(S.WARE_ID))=1)

SELECT COUNT(*)FROM RRL_TT_HU_LOAD_FACT LF JOIN RUSERS U ON U.ID=:B1 WHERE LF.LOAD_OPERATION_ID=:B2 AND LF.WARE_ID>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM RRL_WARES W WHERE W.ID=LF.WARE_ID)AND NVL(U.DELETED,0)=0 AND( (RRL_HAS_WRIGHT(U.ID,'stock_posting_shipping')=1 AND(UPPER(TRIM(U.USER_GROUP))='GLOBAL_ADMIN'OR U.WARE_ID=LF.WARE_ID)) OR RRL_ACCESS_API.ALLOWED(U.ID,'stock_posting_shipping','WAREHOUSE',RRL_STOCK_PLAN_HELPER.DECIMAL_TEXT(LF.WARE_ID))=1)
